subtopics.title: word analogy
subtopics.teaching: Learn word analogy as a core Analogy & Classification competency in Reasoning Challenge. Build the underlying concept, then practise recognition, application, error detection and transfer to unfamiliar questions. Students should explain the reasoning, distinguish strong evidence from distractors, and verify the answer against the wording and constraints.
subtopics.worked_example: Worked example: apply word analogy to a representative problem, identify the decisive clue or rule, work through the reasoning, and verify the result.
subtopics.pitfall: Common pitfall: selecting a familiar-looking answer without checking the exact wording, relationship, sequence, evidence or constraint required by the question.
subtopics.mastery: Mastery: solve an unfamiliar word analogy task independently, explain the reasoning, reject a plausible distractor with evidence, and verify the final answer.
